name: calibrated_natural_v1
description: Z1/Z2 prototype recipe. Conservative natural base whose feature-focal and chroma-evening strengths are designed to be modulated per image by measured facial contrast and skin homogeneity (scripts/spike_z_calibrated_recipe.py). Base values sit at the low end of each op's useful range; the spike raises them only toward measured within-face deficits, never past the profile caps.
